notes.title: Summer Sale 50% off
notes.notes:
It's summer! A great time to do your favorite things and play your favorite games. In honor of this joyous season, we have some exciting news for all gaming enthusiasts.

We are thrilled to announce that our VR games is participating in the Steam Summer Sale! From June 27 to July 11, you can get your hands on our immersive virtual reality adventure at a whopping 50% discount.

So, grab your VR headset and step into a world of adventure.

notes.title: Rock and Roots is now on Oculus Quest
notes.notes:
Dear friends!

We are overjoyed to share with you the exciting news that [u]Rock and Roots[/u] has officially launched on the Oculus Quest Store! This moment marks a significant milestone in our journey, and we couldn't be more thrilled to embark on this virtual adventure alongside each and every one of you.

Your feedback and reviews means the world to us, as they guide us in shaping the future of our game. Your insights, suggestions, and critiques propel us forward on our quest to deliver the ultimate gaming experience.

Thanks for being with us!

[i]Yours ever,
XOCUS[/i]

notes.title: Better and better ✊🏻
notes.notes:
Dear friends, thank you for your feedback! This helps us improve the game and makes it better

Will keep working and creating fun and beauty for you!
 
[i]Yours ever,
